facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at SG-8000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on SG-8000 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. SG-8000 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 16 February 2014 a hazard report was recorded on SG-8000 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during an intrusive maintenance task; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
